name: Richard Lee

attribution.legal_posture: Reuters attributes the forged profile to the DPRK IT-worker scheme; the UN Panel later reproduced the labeled resume as derivative figure evidence. The record carries no criminal charge, conviction, sanctions designation, or verified civil identity.

caveats: The record retains bounded source context; green-card data, portrait, phone, email, account selector, precise address, and apparent identity-owner data stay outside it.
Reuters reported a historical LinkedIn account but published no stable endpoint in the reviewed text; LinkedIn removed the account after Reuters sought comment.

Reuters's accessible syndicated article and reporter post are one underlying person-specific journalism source family; S/2024/215 reproduces the same source material, so identity corroboration remains dependent.
Richard Lee is a common name. The 188-result GitHub exact-full-name search supplies only a common-name result; GitHub account retention is absent.

Richard Lee remains the forged employment-persona label explicitly reported by Reuters and reproduced in an official UN figure; legal name, civil identity, LinkedIn ownership, actual Jumio employment, and present location remain unresolved.
The 72-profile Lazarus.group snapshot contains zero exact Richard Lee profiles; this is bounded negative evidence.
The script's Singapore and Los Angeles statements are persona backstory; actual travel, residence and present location require independent evidence.
